svg.title: MathKX architecture
svg.text: Solid: decided or existing. Dashed: planned or not yet decided. Sources: docs/architecture/architecture.md, ADR 0001–0010, decision log DL-001–DL-040, spec 001.
Monorepo (ADR 0001). Code and docs MIT, content CC BY-SA 4.0 (ADR 0010). Every change is a reviewed pull request.
content/ schemas/ tools/ docs/ Prototype/ exist today; src/ arrives with spec 002
Azure App Service (Linux), region Norway East (ADR 0009)
One deployable: ASP.NET Core host serving the API and the built web app. Learner data stays in region.
JSON definition → named generator → deterministic domain implementation. Registries list what code provides; they carry no logic.
authentication and recovery mechanics, database schema and retention, mastery algorithm,
symbolic equivalence, AI use, Exercise Format v1, generator versioning
(seed proposal → ADR 0011 after C# fixtures, DL-024), parent/teacher relationships (F9 design proposal).
source of the pilot lesson, grammar,
schema and retention: not yet designed
